entries.rootCause: requestFullscreen may exist but reject the navigationUI options object; V1 then hid the PWA fallback merely because the function existed
entries.prevention: retry requestFullscreen without options and show fallback unless fullscreenElement/standalone is actually true

entries.rootCause: V1 only searched Navigator, buttons, hints and eye once at startup
entries.prevention: single idempotent MutationObserver reconcile path plus bounded startup reconciles

entries.rootCause: V1 eye fallback included canvas and could shrink the entire WebGL scene if canvas naming matched eye
entries.prevention: never auto-scale canvas; WebGL eye must register its Object3D

entries.rootCause: canonical runtime used only pointer:coarse and could miss touch-capable iPad/hybrid profiles
entries.prevention: canonical runtime hardening uses pointer + any-pointer + touch/mobile detection while retaining desktop lock

entries.rootCause: canonical runtime treated any #mobileControls node as proof that Golden controls were installed
entries.prevention: only a structurally valid #goldenMobileControls with move/look nodes can satisfy readiness

entries.rootCause: V1 always created a second menu even if shared Golden UI shell was already present
entries.prevention: reuse GoldenUIShell.packed first; create exactly one local fallback only when absent

entries.rootCause: fixed bottom HUD used innerHeight only and could overlap the virtual keyboard
entries.prevention: visualViewport keyboard inset and joystick suppression during text input

entries.rootCause: V1 hid old keyboard hints but added new textual joystick labels despite the final UX requirement
entries.prevention: control labels are explicitly suppressed by policy and CSS
